notes.title: Project C Revealed by BLUMHOUSE GAMES
notes.content:
On stage at Summer Game Fest 2024, Blumhouse CEO and Founder Jason Blum and Blumhouse Games Creative Lead Louise Blain introduced six new games, including "Project C"!

[previewyoutube=XKRnxE7lBds;full][/previewyoutube]

"Project C" is a collaboration between Blumhouse (Get Out, M3GAN, The Black Phone) , Half Mermaid (IMMORTALITY) and Brandon Cronenberg (POSSESSOR, INFINITY POOL)! We hope it will blown your mind. Watch this space for more info as we talk more about the game and the horrors it contains!

THE FUTURE WAS MEANT TO BE BROKEN
